content:
version: "2026.10.7"

# Layer 1 — deterministic guardrails. Default is deny.
agents:
  discovery_agent:
    allowed_tools: [schema_validator, engagement_template_store, knowledge_search, dataset_catalog, industry_taxonomy]
    blocked_tools: [execute_financial_transaction, send_client_email, modify_source_data]
  research_agent:
    allowed_tools: [search_public_web, search_knowledge_base]
    blocked_tools: [execute_financial_transaction, send_client_email]
  data_agent:
    allowed_tools: [schema_lookup, run_sql_readonly]
    blocked_tools: [modify_source_data, send_client_email]
    allowed_tables: [finance.revenue, finance.costs, sales.customers, ops.kpis]
  financial_agent:
    allowed_tools: [query_financial_data, calculate_roi, calculate_npv, calculate_payback, scenario_analysis, sensitivity_analysis, calculate_margin, calculate_growth, derive_annual_benefit]
    requires_approval: [approve_budget, commit_financial_action]
  risk_agent:
    allowed_tools: [risk_lookup, search_knowledge_base]
  solution_agent:
    allowed_tools: []
  report_agent:
    allowed_tools: [render_report]
    requires_approval: [send_client_email]

# Layer 3 — risk-based autonomy
risk_tiers:
  low:    [document_retrieval, data_cleaning, basic_sql, aggregation, summarization, citation_generation]
  medium: [market_interpretation, financial_scenario_generation, risk_classification, strategy_alternatives]
  high:   [financial_commitment, legal_regulatory_conclusion, client_facing_recommendation,
           production_system_modification, sensitive_data_access, major_strategic_decision, external_communication]

thresholds:
  financial_commitment_usd: 1000000      # above this -> ESCALATE
  approval_risk_score: 0.7
  min_groundedness: 0.75
  min_constraint_satisfaction: 0.9
  min_task_adherence: 0.7
  min_tool_call_accuracy: 0.9
  min_contradiction_free: 0.75
  max_guardian_retries: 1

# Provider data-handling rules
data_classification:
  confidential:
    allowed_providers: [azure_openai]
  internal:
    allowed_providers: [azure_openai, openai]
  public:
    allowed_providers: [azure_openai, openai, gemini, local]

# Who may do what. Default deny: a permission not listed here is refused for everyone. "*" = any signed-in user.
rbac:
  engagement:create: ["*"]
  engagement:read: ["*"]
  engagement:approve: [Partner]
  payload:view: [Partner, Admin]      # see tool arguments/results and retrieved text on confidential engagements
  metrics:view: ["*"]
  governance:view: [Admin, Auditor]   # policy, tool registry, provider health, budgets, degradation events

# What may be sent to a model provider. Secrets (keys, tokens, passwords) are NEVER sent, whatever the mode.
# redact: personal identifiers (emails, phone numbers, card and bank numbers) are masked too. allow: they pass.
pii:
  confidential: redact
  internal: redact
  public: allow

# When recent quality slips below the minimums above, the system becomes more cautious by itself
# (stronger model, more retrieval, every run reviewed by a human). It looks at the last `window` runs.
degradation:
  window: 10
  min_runs: 3
  recovery_margin: 0.03
  severe_gap: 0.15

# Capacity limits. Provider limits are global (one provider, one quota), so they are shared by every engagement.
limits:
  providers:
    azure_openai: {requests_per_minute: 600, tokens_per_minute: 150000, max_concurrent: 8, queue_timeout_sec: 20}
  engagements: {max_concurrent: 4, max_queued: 20}

timeouts_sec:
  search: 10
  database: 15
  llm: 30
  workflow: 300
